events.verdict: Harris (DET) and Williams' (CHA) arms get tangled as both players pursue the rebound.
Miller (CHA) trails behind Ivey (DET) and the body contact during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Ivey (DET) applies a forearm to Ball's (CHA) front that affects his SQBR.
Stewart (DET) briefly places an arm around Miller (CHA) as he moves around him to recover the loose ball and the contact is incidental.
Cunningham (DET) places a hand on Green's (CHA) back as he drives past him and immediately removes it. Green does not lose his balance as a result of any illegal contact from Cunningham.

Replay review of the foul called on Williams (CHA) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Williams is not in a vertical position when he initiates illegal body contact with Cunningham (DET) during his layup attempt. Any contact by Cunningham prior to the foul is marginal.
Miller (CHA) maintains a legal guarding position during Beasley's (DET) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Moore Jr. (DET) cleanly dislodges the ball from Mann's (CHA) possession.
After the ball is dislodged by Moore Jr. (DET), Mann (CHA) is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds. Detroit should be given possession of the ball.
Miller (CHA) reaches in and makes contact to Ivey's (DET) arm, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Harris (DET) maintains a legal guarding position during Miller's (CHA) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Miller (CHA) and Stewart (DET) make incidental arm contact with each other pursuing the rebound.
Ivey (DET) steps out of bounds upon receiving the throw-in.
Coach Lee (CHA) signals for a timeout prior to the release of the throw-in and the timeout request is granted.
Martin (CHA) remains within the designated throw-in spot before releasing the pass.
Harris (DET) commits a take foul on Green (CHA).
Green (CHA) moves laterally into Ivey (DET), initiating body contact that affects his SQBR. The contact occurs before Ivey gathers and enters his shooting motion.
Ivey (DET) commits a take foul on Williams (CHA).
Martin (CHA) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Martin (CHA) commits a take foul on Ivey (DET).
Harris (DET) loses control of the ball on his own before Miller (CHA) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away.
